name: vehicle-dealership

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run typecheck && npm run lint
scripts.db:sql:
drizzle-kit export > db/schema.sql.tmp && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const sql=fs.readFileSync('db/schema.sql.tmp','utf8');fs.writeFileSync('src/db/bootstrap-sql.ts','/* AUTO-GENERATED from src/db/schema.ts via drizzle-kit export. Regenerate with: npm run db:sql */
export const SCHEMA_SQL = '+JSON.stringify(sql)+';
');fs.writeFileSync('db/schema.sql','-- Full schema. OPTIONAL: the app creates it automatically on an empty database.
'+sql);fs.unlinkSync('db/schema.sql.tmp')"

description: Bilingual (Arabic RTL / English) vehicle dealership platform with admin dashboard, sales & rentals, and an interactive vehicle finder.
